lead.title: OpenEvidence raises $250M at $15B valuation for AI medical search engine
lead.summary: OpenEvidence, an AI-powered medical search engine often called 'ChatGPT for medicine,' is raising $250M at a $15B valuation. Andreessen Horowitz and hospital systems are among the investors, underscoring the market's bet on AI for clinical decision support.

top_stories.title: Island raises $400M at $6.4B valuation for AI-era enterprise browser security
top_stories.summary: Evolution Equity Partners led the Series F for Island's enterprise browser, which positions itself as the security control point for AI-age workflows and data governance.

top_stories.title: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu V900 AI chip to rival Huawei Ascend 960 in China's domestic market
top_stories.summary: Alibaba's T-Head Semiconductor division unveiled the Zhenwu V900 at Apsara Conference, competing directly with Huawei's Ascend 960 as US export controls accelerate domestic AI silicon development.

top_stories.title: Hermes Agent gets fast free web search via Perplexity across all Nous Portal tiers
top_stories.summary: Nous Research integrated Perplexity's Photon Fast Search as the default search backend in Hermes Agent, delivering 160ms p50 latency for agentic search — now free for all tiers.

top_stories.title: Feather Robotics launches $30K modular humanoid platform for developers
top_stories.summary: Founded by ex-1X and ex-Tesla engineers, Feather Robotics' modular humanoid lets developers customize hardware for different use cases. Backed by Gradient Ventures, with robots already deployed as cooks in Japan and cleaning labs.

items.title: GRASP: a multi-stage LLM planning framework for strategic agents
items.summary: A strategy-aware multi-stage planning framework using LLMs that generates, revises, and assesses executable plans for complex tasks.

items.title: Rufus-Air: open 8-stage post-training recipe for 106B MoE models
items.summary: Reproducible 8-stage post-training pipeline (SFT, reasoning/coding/agent RL, RLHF) on GLM-4.5-Air-Base 106B MoE, making advanced post-training fully open-source.

items.title: Beyond Average Safety: chance-constrained fine-tuning bounds per-prompt risk
items.summary: Introduces chance-constrained fine-tuning that bounds safety regression risk on a per-prompt basis rather than controlling average safety loss.

items.title: SLCA-GRPO: fixing credit misattribution in tool-calling RL agents
items.summary: Fixes GRPO credit assignment in tool-calling agents by segment-level advantage computation, preventing structural misattribution across heterogeneous outputs.

items.title: Forecast-Dojo: replayable benchmark for training and evaluating LLM forecasting agents
items.summary: Combines resolved prediction-market questions with dated news to create replayable environments for LLM-based forecasting agents.

items.title: IterSynth: role-decoupled deep search agents outperform ReAct-style architectures
items.summary: Separates planning, evidence retrieval, and synthesis into distinct modules, outperforming ReAct-style agents on deep search tasks.

items.title: 5 million industrial robots now operating in factories worldwide, IFR reports
items.summary: Global operational stock of industrial robots hit 5 million units, up 9%, with annual installations exceeding 600,000. China continues to lead installations.

items.title: O-ID raises $1.2M for modular humanoid robots targeting Japan's industrial sector
items.summary: Tokyo-based O-ID raised pre-seed funding led by TAWANI Ventures for its fully modular humanoid robot, positioned to leverage Japan's $65B physical AI investment initiative.

items.title: Epson introduces AX6 collaborative robot with no-code programming
items.summary: Epson's AX6 cobot features power- and force-limiting for safe human-robot collaboration without safety barriers, targeting manufacturers facing labor shortages.

items.title: Clueso MCP connects AI agents to a video creation engine
items.summary: Agents can produce on-brand product videos, demos, and customer education content from raw screen recordings entirely through chat. All outputs stay editable.

items.title: Naise AI runs autonomous marketing campaigns from a single brief
items.summary: Handles social media, influencer outreach, PR, and image generation with persistent memory for brand guidelines. Prompt Playbooks automate execution in any language.

items.title: WZRD turns documents into interactive AI experiences you can talk to
items.summary: Upload files or prompted content to create interactive AI documents, slides, and forms that respond conversationally. No coding required.

items.title: Jev-browse delegates browser operations to lighter sub-tasks at roughly 1/3 cost
items.summary: Lets coding agents outsource navigation, clicks, and data extraction to lighter sub-tasks, reducing token and time cost by about two-thirds compared to full-agent browsing.

items.title: Precision Neuroscience raises $250M for minimally invasive brain-computer interfaces
items.summary: Pershing Square Inc. and Ackman Oxman Institute co-led the Series D for the BCI company developing brain implants without open-skull surgery.

items.title: Basecamp Research raises $140M Series C for AI drug discovery on proprietary biological data
items.summary: The Series C funds AI training on proprietary biological datasets to accelerate drug discovery and computational biology.

items.title: BigHat Biosciences raises $75M for AI-driven protein design and antibody-drug conjugates
items.summary: DFJ Growth and Premji Invest co-led the Series C for the AI biotechnology company focused on therapeutic protein design.

items.title: PicoJool raises $27.5M to attack the optical interconnect bottleneck inside AI clusters
items.summary: Socratic Partners led the Series A for the semiconductor startup developing optical interconnects to solve data movement bottlenecks in AI training clusters.
